summary: First-run E2E testing for Relic vault app. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases passed covering vault create/enter (incl. dup 409, wrong-passcode 401), /vault/me auth, memory CRUD for all 4 types with non-zero 3D coords, invalid type 400, capsule zero-leak masking (future locked -> content/media/audio/caption all null and is_locked=true in create/GET/list; past unlocked -> full content), PATCH is_scratched persistence, DELETE removal, cross-vault isolation (vault B cannot GET or list vault A's memory), file upload + auth-gated download (401 without token, 200 with ?auth=token). Frontend: entrance loads with RELIC branding, Enter/New Vault tabs work, wrong passcode surfaces error toast, vault creation navigates to /vault with 'Vault forged. Welcome home.' toast, ambient dock renders with ambient-player + cosmic/rain/fireplace/tape channel buttons + mute + volume slider, add-memory modal opens on add-memory-btn, letter type selection + title/author/content submission creates memory, success toast 'A new star joins your sky ✦' shown, modal closes, and 'memories in orbit' counter increments 0->1. Star appears in constellation. No critical bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: /api/files/{path} decodes JWT but does not verify the token's vault_id matches the file's vault_id — any valid vault token can download any other vault's file if the storage path is known. Consider scoping by vault_id.
Minor: unlock_at is stored as a raw string; datetime.fromisoformat won't accept trailing 'Z' (Python <3.11 caveat). Currently OK on 3.11, but frontend should send offset-aware ISO strings.
Nit: MemoryUpdate treats explicit None as 'no change'; means clients cannot clear a field via PATCH. Acceptable for current scope.
test_credentials: Shared-vault passcode auth. Seed vault 'Aurora & Kai' / 'starlight' per /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Tests create their own TEST_ vaults dynamically.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral TEST_Vault_A_<uuid>, TEST_Vault_B_<uuid> and UI_Test_<uuid> vaults + several TEST_ memories. Cleanup not implemented (uses unique names per run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend testids match: mode-enter-btn, mode-create-btn, vault-name-input, vault-passcode-input, vault-submit-btn (entrance uses a shared form for both modes, NOT tab-enter/tab-create/enter-*-input as the review-request example suggested). In /vault: add-memory-btn, ambient-player, ambient-{cosmic,rain,fireplace,tape}-btn, ambient-mute-btn, ambient-volume, ambient-toggle-btn. Modal: add-memory-modal, add-close-btn, type-{letter,polaroid,milestone,capsule}-btn, mem-title-input, mem-author-input, mem-content-input, mem-submit-btn (mem-unlock-input only appears when capsule type is selected).
